items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He was my manager’s son, Carley – Dale Carley, a great little player.

ctx.x: I was just going to say Lew Soloff. Let’s see. Who else was in there? A little cat that ended up in the Basie band. He was my manager’s son, Carley – Dale Carley, a great little player. We had Victor Sproles on bass. Don Friedman was there for a while, and – I can see these cats. I can’t call all their names right now.
Did Ron Carter play in that band?
